verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs describe a dedicated Sandbox environment: API keys are issued in Sandbox and can call the APIs immediately, KYB passes automatically there, and a sandbox test-case guide demonstrates multiple KYC/KYB flows. This lets integrators test without live operations. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that Sandbox data is isolated from production, details on sandbox simulation of money movement or resetting data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
